title: Coding Agents Still Need Human Rework

lines: A new signal on coding-agent performance is up.

body: Alibaba’s Co-Design Bench found GPT-6 Astra fully solved only 26.4% of real-world coding tasks, leaving nearly three-quarters needing human rework. But Qwen3.8-Max surpassed it in large-scale code rewriting, showing results vary sharply by task.
